leadText: Volume 2 is the second volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga authored and illustrated by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.
plainText:
Volume 2 is the second volume of the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! manga authored and illustrated by 伊原しげかつ Shigekatsu Ihara.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: Beauty Contest: The Pokémon Super Contest!!
Chapter 2: Dialga's Secret Keys
Chapter 3: Team Galactic's Conspiracy, Revealed!!
Chapter 4: Challenge! The Fortress Of Steel!!
Chapter 5: Serious Training on Iron Island!!

==Important events==
Hareta and Mitsumi meet the Champion Cynthia.
Hareta meets Cyrus and has a battle, resulting in a loss.
Hareta is trained by Byron.
While training on Iron Island, Hareta meets Riley and receives a Pokémon Egg from him.

==Party changes==
Mitsumi is revealed to have an .

===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
Hareta's in DPA09
Hareta's in DPA09
Hareta's in DPA09

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Hareta's to in DPA09
Jun's to prior to DPA08

==Gym Battles==
Hareta defeats the following Gym Leaders:

Maylene in DPA07
Crasher Wake in DPA07
Fantina in DPA07
He also challenges Byron in DPA08, but did not win the battle.

==D・P Snapshots==
Please stop Crying! (泣きやんで！)
Planting Seeds (種まき)
Mitsumi Sows. (植えるミツミ)
Piplup Reaps. (ほるポッチャマ)
Nap Time (おひるねタイム)
Sleep tight! (おやすみ) 
Wake Up! (起きてー！)
Skywards! (空へ！)
Piplup In Flight!(空飛ぶポッチャマ！)
Actually...(じつは......)

==Character summary==
===Hareta's party===
 

==Trivia==
 
As the English volumes do not have dust covers like the Japanese ones, part two of the back cover gag is lost in the English release. The front cover image is moved to the end of the volume and changed into an explanation of the direction the book reads in.
===Errors===
In the D・P Snapshots section, the sound effects next to and are part of their names. The English edition does not carry this over with Chimecho and Chingling, instead having "TING" and "CLANG".
